title: Occupational Lung Disease
subtitle: What occupational lung disease is, causes, risk factors, symptoms, evaluation, management, lifestyle considerations, and safety.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports workplace exposures as primary causes of occupational lung diseases; treatment and prevention strategies are based on clinical guidelines and epidemiologic studies. Emerging evidence focuses on genetic susceptibility and novel biomarkers, but requires further validation.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
